Frequently asked questions

Can I control everything from my phone?

Yes. Gates, AC, lights and sensors can be controlled and monitored from your phone.

Can you automate an existing villa?

Yes. Most automation can be added to existing homes without major rewiring.

Do you install automatic gates?

Yes — gate motors for sliding and swing gates, with remote and phone control.
